summary: Regression verification after api.js refactor (BASE ? `${BASE}/api` : '/api'). Preview has REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL set so BASE is truthy and the same axios baseURL path as before is exercised. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests pass. Additional smoke on requested endpoints: GET /api/ 200, POST /api/auth/login 200, GET /api/auth/me 200, GET /api/kpis 200 (domain_counts = business:10, application:3, data:4, security:3, integration:3, technology:4 - matches spec), GET /api/admin/ldap 200 (server_url ldaps://ad.bot.go.tz:636, EAMS-Admins->admin, EAMS-Reviewers->reviewer), GET /api/reports 200, GET /api/dr/coverage 200 (note: actual path is /api/dr/coverage, not /api/dr-coverage), GET /api/capabilities/heatmap 200. Frontend Playwright walkthrough: login -> dashboard -> 6 domain KPI cards render with correct counts -> /admin/ldap loads with saved settings visible -> /reports loads -> /dr-coverage loads -> /capabilities/heatmap loads rendering the maturity x strategic grid with CAP-01/CAP-02/CAP-03 placed. Zero console errors observed. api.js refactor is non-regressive on preview.

minor.issue: Frontend route is /dr-coverage but backend endpoint is /api/dr/coverage (slash, not hyphen). Not a bug (frontend calls the correct path) but worth noting for spec alignment.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/lib/api.js is clean: single source of truth for API base, correctly falls back to same-origin '/api' when REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is empty (needed by on-prem nginx same-origin deploy) and preserves cross-origin behaviour when set (preview). No callers appear to import a hardcoded URL.

/app/frontend/nginx.conf and /app/docker-compose.yml are production-only artifacts and are not exercised by the preview supervisor; therefore they cannot be validated here. The on-prem 3003 refuse-connection reported by the user is confirmed to be a host-side stale docker-compose (still running colecle_caddy) - the fix is deploy-side (docker compose down --remove-orphans, sync the new compose file, docker compose up -d --build).
seed_data_creation: None - relied on existing seeded data (27 objects, LDAP settings persisted from prior admin save).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview app is fully green after the api.js refactor. Regression suite /app/backend/tests/test_eams_api.py is the canonical reference. Backend DR endpoint is /api/dr/coverage (slash). Ldap admin endpoint is /api/admin/ldap and returns bind_password_set boolean (never the actual password).
rca of the issue: N/A - reported issue is host-side deploy mismatch on the user's Docker host, cannot be reproduced in preview. Preview code is regression-free.
